clauses.requirement: The rear lamp type shall be subject to conformity of production control procedures meeting the minimum requirements of UN R148 Annex 4.
General provisions of UN R148 Annex 4 for conformity of production control of the rear lamp shall be applied (paragraphs 1.1 to 1.4).

Conformity of production lamps shall be considered satisfying the requirements from a mechanical and geometric standpoint if differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of UN R148.

With respect to photometric performances, conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested when the photometric performances of any lamp chosen at random are tested according to paragraph 4.8 of UN R148.
In the case of a lamp equipped with a replaceable light source, if the photometric test results do not meet the requirements, the tests on lamps shall be repeated using another standard light source.
The chromaticity coordinates of the lamp shall be complied with when tested under the conditions of paragraph 4.9 of UN R148.

In the case of non-replaceable filament light source(s) or light source module(s) equipped with non-replaceable filament light source(s), at any conformity of production check the type approval holder shall demonstrate the use in normal production and show the identification of the non-replaceable filament light source(s) as indicated in the type approval documentation.

For each type of lamp, the type approval holder shall carry out at least the minimum verification tests at appropriate intervals, in accordance with the provisions of UN R148; if any sampling shows non-conformity for the type of test concerned, further samples shall be taken and tested; the manufacturer shall take steps to ensure conformity of the production concerned.
